manifest.holdoutDefinition: closed candles strictly after discoveryCutoff; never used for candidate selection

multipleTesting.selectionRule: effect size + fold stability + symbol breadth; no single p-value selection
multipleTesting.confidenceInterval: deterministic bootstrap 2.5%-97.5% interval per calibration bucket

calibration.monotonicDefinition: higher entry_edge_score should not reduce realized label expectancy
